request: Add a 2 millimetre fillet to the edges of the scrolling wheel slot to ensure a smooth surface.

actions.target: Edges of the scrolling wheel slot
actions.relational_constraint: Fillet is applied to the slot edge geometry (i.e., along the edges belonging to the scrolling wheel slot).
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify which specific edges of the scrolling wheel slot are intended (e.g., all perimeter edges of the slot, only top opening edges, only internal/bottom edges, or both sides if the slot passes through).

intention: Ensure a smooth surface at the scrolling wheel slot by rounding its edges.
